fact_text: In a PMEX code such as CRUDE 10 JA25 ID, the number is the barrel size, JA25 is the January 2025 expiry, and the ID suffix marks an intraday contract.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'What are Initial Margin & Contract Code ? Learn PMEX Insights ! Pakistan Mercantile Exchange' (YouTube, 2024-12-11)

fact_text: An intraday contract is opened and closed on the same day and closes automatically at the end of that day, whereas a normal contract can be held for up to three months.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'What are Initial Margin & Contract Code ? Learn PMEX Insights ! Pakistan Mercantile Exchange' (YouTube, 2024-12-11)

fact_text: The initial margin on an intraday contract is half of the initial margin on a normal contract of the same size, so intraday traders post 50% of the normal amount.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'What are Initial Margin & Contract Code ? Learn PMEX Insights ! Pakistan Mercantile Exchange' (YouTube, 2024-12-11)

fact_text: PMEX lists crude oil contracts of 10, 100 and 1,000 barrels, and the 100-barrel crude contract is a normal three-month contract.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'What are Initial Margin & Contract Code ? Learn PMEX Insights ! Pakistan Mercantile Exchange' (YouTube, 2024-12-11)

fact_text: PMEX margin in rupees moves with the USD/PKR rate, so PMEX updates its daily margin sheet to reflect the exchange rate.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'What are Initial Margin & Contract Code ? Learn PMEX Insights ! Pakistan Mercantile Exchange' (YouTube, 2024-12-11)
